# Product README — pre-ship checklist

## Routing

- [ ] Installable / OSS / agent landing — not a platform-layer numbered overview
- [ ] Platform service → `readable-readme`; package map → `extensive-readme`
- [ ] If extensive companion: banner links to `docs/EXTENSIVE.md`

## Kind

- [ ] Named host-run product uses the category landing; library uses promise + proof
- [ ] "The first / world's first" only with a narrow category and tree-true counts
- [ ] No padded third inventory number

## First screen (required)

Host-run product:

- [ ] Category line uses words a stranger already has; coined class names are defined once before prompts, not in the heading
- [ ] Conversion: turn {host} into {job}; stages exist in this tree
- [ ] Body does not restack the category sentence; GitHub About holds "world's first"
- [ ] Count line is tree-true
- [ ] One nearby-wrong, primary interface, one invariant
- [ ] Proof: demo/screenshot and/or a command that does the job (`--help` is not the check)
- [ ] No internals codes, no chatbot dunk, no PAS

Library:

- [ ] What it is and what it is not
- [ ] Primary interface named
- [ ] One invariant
- [ ] Proof command or recorded demo

Shared:

- [ ] Badges/nav only include URLs that exist
- [ ] Logo: character mark for host-run if adding one; flat mark for libraries
- [ ] New SVG is original (no trademarked mascot)

## Teaching

- [ ] 1–5 named techniques, each with mechanism + **limit**
- [ ] Citation URLs verified or omitted
- [ ] No slogan claims or invented benchmarks
- [ ] Field guide optional; no `## 1. Vision` numbering

## Shape

- [ ] Host-run: prompts + quick start after proof/workspace, before a long catalog
- [ ] Library: get started after a short teach
- [ ] Catalogs live in `docs/` or `extensive-readme`
- [ ] License stated if the repo has one

## Critique loop (required)

- [ ] Stranger can steal the category sentence
- [ ] Host-run README has a turn-X-into-Y line
- [ ] Counts are tree-true
- [ ] Next action is a prompt or proof command
- [ ] Skill patched only if a **general** rule was missing (still no customer names)

## Anti-slop and copy (required)

Run [../copywriting/scorecard.md](../copywriting/scorecard.md) and
[../readme/anti-slop.md](../readme/anti-slop.md) **Pass**. Rewrite until clean.

- [ ] One idea; prompt or proof command is the action
- [ ] No "not just X, it's Y" punch; is / is not is one factual nearby-wrong
- [ ] No AI vocabulary stack, -ing tails, "serves as", em dashes, Title Case headings
